roe deer.d: small graceful deer of Eurasian woodlands having small forked antlers

roentgen ray.d: electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target

roe.d: fish eggs or egg-filled ovary; having a grainy texture

roentgenography.d: radiography that uses X-rays to produce a roentgenogram

roentgenogram.d: a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays; used in medical diagnosis

roebling.d: United States engineer (born in Germany) who designed and began construction of the Brooklyn bridge (1806-1869)

roentgenoscope.d: an X-ray machine that combines an X-ray source and a fluorescent screen to enable direct observation

roentgenographic.d: relating to or produced by roentgenography
